function.name: check_eligibility
function.description: Check whether a student meets the academic eligibility criteria (CGPA cutoff, allowed engineering branches, and maximum active backlog restrictions) for a visiting recruitment company.

company.description: Name of the visiting recruiter (e.g., 'Google', 'Microsoft', 'Amazon', 'TCS', 'Infosys', 'Deloitte', 'Flipkart', 'Goldman Sachs', 'Wipro', 'Accenture').

cgpa.description: Student's current Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) on a 10.0 scale (e.g., 8.25).

backlogs.description: Number of standing/active backlogs or arrears the student currently has. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

function.name: get_upcoming_drives
function.description: Retrieve the official schedule of upcoming campus placement drives, with optional filters for student's branch and CGPA to show matching opportunities.

branch.description: Optional engineering branch filter to view only drives open to this department.

min_cgpa.description: Optional student's CGPA (e.g., 7.5) to filter and retrieve drives where the student meets the minimum CGPA cutoff requirement.

function.name: interview_tips
function.description: Fetch structured interview preparation guides, round-by-round breakdown, common technical/behavioral topics, and recommended study resources for a company or company category.

company_or_role.description: Target company name ('Google', 'Microsoft', 'Amazon', 'Goldman Sachs', 'TCS', 'Infosys', 'Deloitte') or recruiting sector ('product', 'service', 'consulting', 'startup', 'finance') or job role ('SDE', 'Analyst').

function.name: check_application_status
function.description: Track a student's real-time campus placement applications, current hiring stage (e.g., Applied, Shortlisted, Interview Scheduled, Selected), and scheduled next steps using their college student ID.

student_id.description: The unique college student identification number (e.g., 'STU001', 'STU002', 'STU003', 'STU004', 'STU005', 'STU006').
